grass.note: The meadow: the first grass, its closest sister over half, the open sister in patches, the worn grass in spots. Tone variation is the shader's tint, never another image.

forest.note: The floor of the woods: the flattest grass in the shade, the sparse forest grass in a few plaques, a third of the bare spots kept. Plain soil does not come out of the generator.

water.note: The river: one seamless water (Scenario) laid in two layers flowing along the current the server sends, the streaks of the current over it where it runs fast (streaks); the bank, the fords and the beaches are drawn by the water meshes' shaders from the vertices (WaterMeshes, D36); the brooks by their own ribbon (BrookLines) over their beds.

decor.note: Decorations sown by a fixed hash of the tile (client-side trial, no effect on the game).

shore.note: Shore: the bank is drawn from the vertices of the water meshes (WaterMeshes, D36, 11 November 2026); the distance-field texture of 9 November and the bank pieces before it are gone.
